Dalajītasiṃha
by Kṛṣṇalāla Varmā.
C.. Arrah I. A. p. 14 (Pt..).

Daladā_Aṣṭaka
Bud. on the sacred tooth relic. Colombo D. I. 905-06. 908-10.
--Pāli. Colombo D. I. 907 (with Sinhalese transl.) 1244.

Daladāsirita
Bud. Pāli. History of Tooth Relic. Colombo p. 53. [Page338-b]

Dalapati
See Umāpati Dalapati, NCC. II. p. 392a.

Dalapatirāja
son of Vallabha of Bhāradvāja gotra; pupil of Sūryapaṇḍita; minister of Nijāmsāha of Devagiri.
See Kane, HDS. I. p.. 406-10.
--Nṛsim3haprasāda. encyclopaedic treatise on dh. in 12 sections. Composed between 1490-1512 A. D. IO. 1467. RASB. III. 2038.
Mss. of diff. sections are found separately. For details see under individual titles.
--Āhnikasāra.
--Kālanirṇaya(sāra). Bikaner 1688.
--Tīrthasāra. C.. II. 332.
--Dānasāra. Baroda 1975. Bik. 920.
--Pratiṣṭhāsāra. Oudh XI. 12.
--Prāyaścittasāra. NW. 98.
--Vratasāra. NW. 74. Sūcīpattra 35.
--Śāntisāra. Bik. 921. Oudh. X. 18.
--Srāddhasāra. Sūcīpattra 36.
--Sam3skārasāra. NP. V. 158. SB. 127.

Dalapatirāma
son of Durgārāma, grandson of Govindarāma; disciple of Śrīkṛṣṇabhaṭṭa.
--C. Bālavibodhinī composed in 1818 A. D. on Gaṅgālaharī of Jagannātha Paṇḍita. Bomb. Uni. 2161. RASB. II. 5669.

Dalapatirāma
or ºrAya disciple of Gosvāmi Vrajabhūṣaṇa Śarman; patronised by Mādhavasim3ha, prob. ruler of Jaipur (1750-68 A. D.).
--Yavanaparipāṭyanukrama or Patrapraśasti. composed in 1764 A. D. a. the instance of his preceptor. Bhr. [Page339-a. 409. Intro. p. 41. BORI. 409 of 1882-83.

Dalapatirāma
--Pattralekhaprakārādeśa. Tod. 98.
Prob. same a. above.

Dalīla
or Hillāja. name of Roman astrology.
Ref. to by Rāmeśvara in Hillājavyākhyā, Peters. IV. Extr. p. 61.

Dalhaṇa
--C. on Suśrutasam3hitā. TD. 11166.
See above Ḍalhaṇa, p. 6a.

Dālbhya
ancient authority on dh. [Page032-a.
--Dālbhyasmṛti or ºdharmaśāstra. BORI. 267 of 1887-91.
The following may be sections of the above work.
--Ūrdhvadehakriyāvidhi. Adyar I. p. 107a.
--Kāyasthotpatti. Kavīndrācārya 1313.
--Kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśījananaśānti. Adyar I. p. 96a.
--Tripiṇḍīvidhi. B. I. 224.
--Daśāhādikarma. BORI. 218 of 1884-87.
--Nārāyanabali. IM. 3167.
--Nārāyaṇabalipaddhati. Baroda 11497.
--Puttalavidhāna. dh. BORI. 125 of 1884-86. Peters. III. p. 388 (no. 125). Weber 1113.

Dālbhyapaddhati
dh. on rites pertaining to death an. after death. Baroda 8156. IM. 5684 (inc.).
C.. Dālbhyasmṛti below.

Dālbhyapariśiṣṭa
Q. by Bhāskararāya in his C. Saubhāgyabhāskara on Lalitāsahasranāma p. 24. N. S. Press edn. 1935.

Dālbhyastotra
Ani. IM. 4850. 4851 (inc.). 10141. Prob. same a. Apāmārjanastotra or ºkalpa.

Dālbhyasmṛti
or Dharmaśāstra in verse with prose passages; mostly on funerary rites an. śrāddha; passages common to Likhita an. Śaṅkh. smṛtis. See Kane, HDS. I. p.. 563b. 702b.
Bd. 267 (inc.). Bik. 802. 973 (col. Dālbhyaproktāyām sam3hitāyām Śaṅkhasmṛti). Bikaner 1424-25. IM. 3396 (inc.). IO. 1338 (shorter recension of Likhitasmṛti).
